name: blckalpaca-agentic-audit
description: Checks public websites for AI-agent readiness and GEO, and backs every finding with guides from the Blck Alpaca Knowledge Base on SEO, GEO, AI agents and social media.

interface.longDescription:
A technical website audit for AI-agent readiness and generative engine optimization (GEO): it checks whether AI agents can find, read, understand and act on a public website. The audit fetches the site the way agents do and scores five areas: access, machine understanding, discoverability, EU transparency and privacy signals, and actionability. You get a transparent score, the evidence behind every finding, the three changes with the most impact, and a guide from the Blck Alpaca Knowledge Base for each of them.

The Knowledge Base can also be searched on its own: more than 400 articles, each in German, English and Slovak, on SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO), AI agents (including the Model Context Protocol, RAG and the EU AI Act) and social media, written for companies in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Answers cite the article they come from, with a link and the date of the last content change.

What the plugin does not do: it never changes a website, does not log in anywhere, and gives no legal assessment. EU signals such as an imprint, a privacy notice or AI labelling are detected, not certified.

Built and maintained by Blck Alpaca, a data-driven marketing and AI agency in Vienna.
defaultPrompt: Audit my website for AI-agent readiness and GEO.
Turn the audit findings into a prioritized 90-day roadmap.
What does the Blck Alpaca Knowledge Base say about llms.txt?

publication.release_notes: First public version: website audit for AI-agent readiness and GEO, plus search and full-text access to the Blck Alpaca Knowledge Base in German, English and Slovak.

positive.description: Audit a public website and explain the result.
positive.prompt: Audit orf.at for AI-agent readiness and GEO. What are the three most important fixes?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls audit_website once with url orf.at. Reports the overall score and grade, names three high-impact fixes grounded in the returned findings with their evidence, offers the link to the full report and notes the limits of an automated public check. Live sites change, so the score can differ between runs.

positive.description: Turn audit findings into a roadmap.
positive.prompt: Audit willhaben.at and turn the findings into a prioritized 90-day implementation roadmap.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls audit_website and builds a roadmap ordered by impact and effort, structured in the Analyze, Learn, Perform, Adapt, Connect and Accelerate stages. Every recommendation traces back to a finding in the audit result.

positive.description: Explain a single finding with a source.
positive.prompt: My audit says the site has no structured data (JSON-LD). Why does that matter for AI agents and how do I fix it?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the Knowledge Base, fetches the most relevant article, explains the issue and the fix in plain language, and cites the article title, link and last content change date.

positive.description: Answer a GEO question from the Knowledge Base in German.
positive.prompt: Was sagt die Blck Alpaca Knowledge Base zu GEO-Tools wie Profound und Peec AI?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches with locale de, fetches the matching article, summarizes its comparison and selection criteria in German without adding claims that are not in the article, and links the source.

positive.description: Browse the Knowledge Base without a search term.
positive.prompt: Which topics does the Blck Alpaca Knowledge Base cover on AI agents? List the articles on the Model Context Protocol.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the categories, picks the AI agents category and the Model Context Protocol topic, and returns its articles with links.

negative.description: Unrelated request. The plugin only covers website audits and SEO, GEO and AI-agent knowledge, so no tool should be called. Expected: ChatGPT answers on its own without the plugin.
negative.prompt: Give me a recipe for tiramisu.

negative.description: Request to change a website. The plugin is read-only and cannot edit any site, so no tool is called to make the change. Expected: ChatGPT says the plugin cannot change websites and, if helpful, describes the robots.txt rule the user can add themselves.
negative.prompt: Change the robots.txt on my website so that GPTBot is blocked.

negative.description: Request for a legal certification. The plugin detects signals such as an imprint or privacy notice but gives no legal assessment, so it must not present an audit result as compliance. Expected: ChatGPT declines the certification and points to legal advice; it may offer an automated check clearly labeled as non-legal.
negative.prompt: Confirm in a legally binding way that example.com complies with the GDPR and the EU AI Act.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, process payments or link to checkout flows.
